textbookBox.concept: You eat a roti at lunch. By evening it is gone, but it has become energy and part of your body. How? Animals use food through digestion, breathing, circulation and excretion.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 science · Life Processes in Animals · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Animals cannot make their own food. They get nutrients by eating plants or other animals. Digestion is breaking food into small simple substances the body can absorb.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Animals cannot make their own food. They get nutrients by eating plants or other animals. Digestion is breaking food into small simple substances the body can absorb.
beats.speakEn: Animals cannot make their own food. They get nutrients by eating plants or other animals. Digestion is breaking food into small simple substances the body can absorb.

beats.en: In aerobic respiration, cells use oxygen to release energy from food. Exhaled air has more carbon dioxide and less oxygen than inhaled air. The lungs exchange gases. Fish use gills and insects use tiny tubes.
beats.speakEn: In aerobic respiration, cells use oxygen to release energy from food. Exhaled air has more carbon dioxide and less oxygen than inhaled air. The lungs exchange gases. Fish use gills and insects use tiny tubes.

type: Key Concept: Animals cannot make their own food. They get nutrients by eating plants or other animals.
Rule: In aerobic respiration, cells use oxygen to release energy from food.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 science · Life Processes in Animals · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: The heart pumps blood through blood vessels to every part of the body. Blood carries food and oxygen to cells and takes away waste. Red blood cells carry oxygen. Plasma carries food.

beats.en: The heart pumps blood through blood vessels to every part of the body. Blood carries food and oxygen to cells and takes away waste. Red blood cells carry oxygen. Plasma carries food. White blood cells fight germs.
beats.speakEn: The heart pumps blood through blood vessels to every part of the body. Blood carries food and oxygen to cells and takes away waste. Red blood cells carry oxygen. Plasma carries food. White blood cells fight germs.

beats.en: Excretion is removing waste from the body. The kidneys filter blood and make urine. Lungs remove carbon dioxide and the skin removes sweat.
beats.speakEn: Excretion is removing waste from the body. The kidneys filter blood and make urine. Lungs remove carbon dioxide and the skin removes sweat.

type: The heart pumps blood through blood vessels to every part of the body.
Excretion is removing waste from the body. The kidneys filter blood and make urine.
